snippet.title: Forest Construction VR Demo Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2989140/Forest_Construction_VR/?beta=0

In Forest Construction you will have the opportunity to experience all the joy of free construction with realistic physics, while being in a pleasant forest environment. A sandbox where the only limit is your imagination. Create a simple shelter or a piece of art? It's up to you!
